comment: pins: maxNightsPerDinner 1 - nine evenings need more dishes than the eight-dish pool holds, so the rotation cooks one dish twice and names the rule (poolTooSmallForThePeriod) instead of leaving the ninth evening empty; and a dish that runs one night buys the pot for one night, which is half the standing ask. That second pin is new: the ask used to be measured against itself, so a one-night dish was bought at the two-night pot.
